definitions.gloss: to pass through; to cut through
definitions.explanation: To move through and come out the other side of a space, passage, or area. Used for physically traversing tunnels, crowds, forests, and similar spaces.

examples.japanese: ⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}けた。
{人混|ひとご}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}ける⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}した→苦労する：25357_kurousuru⟧。
examples.english: I had a hard time getting through the crowd.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裏道|うらみち}→裏道：19428_uramichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}ける⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{五分|ごふん}→五分：09573_gofun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{着|つ}ける→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: If you cut through the back street, you can reach the station in five minutes.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ (to pass) and ⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (to come out, to exit). The ⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ component adds the sense of emerging on the other side. Ichidan conjugation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}ける (to pass through a tunnel)
- {人混|ひとご}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}ける (to push through a crowd)
- ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}ける (to go through a forest)
- ⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}ける (to cut through an alley)

The particle ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ marks the space being traversed. Unlike ⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ alone, {通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}ける emphasizes coming out the other side, not just passing along.
